defects.description: The role check is implemented, but the rule that the signing user must differ from record['operator_id'] is not. An operator holding the QA role can sign their own batch.
update_field blocks edits only when status is RELEASED. R4 requires blocking when status is SIGNED, so a signed record that is not yet RELEASED can still be modified.
sign_off calls notify_qa_lead, which prints a notification. The spec defines no notification behaviour; the call is unrequested side effect.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() produces a UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, as R3 requires. Timezone-aware datetimes can look unusual but comply.
update_field writes any field without a status check other than RELEASED. R4 only restricts field updates by status, so the unrestricted write is not itself a spec violation beyond D2.
